description.en: Slow blue fluid folds refract through vertical frosted-glass ribs behind a fixed white LeiBox logo.
description.zh: 蓝色流体缓慢折叠流动，经竖向毛玻璃棱纹折射，中央白色 LeiBox 标志保持固定。

keywords: 蓝色 棱纹 流动 背景 毛玻璃 竖纹 流体 渐变 品牌 标志 blue fluted ribbed frosted glass fluid gradient background logo LeiBox

discovery.caveat: 替换演示 Logo；正文需要在流动背景上保持可读。

source.implementation: Independent WebGL reconstruction from observed video frames; existing LeiBox vector artwork embedded locally.
source.license: Original design/source license not supplied or verified; no original code or video is included in the component package.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Watch the blue folds flow behind the fixed LeiBox logo. Click, tap, or press Space or Enter to pause and resume. Reduced motion shows a still frame.
instructions.zh: 观察 LeiBox 标志背后的蓝色流体与棱纹变化。点击、轻触，或按空格与回车暂停和继续；减少动态效果时显示静帧。
